highlights.title: Edited drafts show as a chip
highlights.text: Change a draft an agent wrote and a chip over the message box says so, with how many lines changed, View and ×. Once sent, the same chip sits under your message, and Show opens the draft.

media.alt: An agent's Slack draft is changed, and a chip over the message box says "Your edited Slack message · 2 lines changed" with View and a cross. Sent with "Post it, with my changes", the same chip sits under the message with Show.

highlights.title: One row per login in Usage
highlights.text: The Usage panel shows each login as one short row: how long it'll last and what it's spent today. Click a row for its week chart, 5-hour window and buttons.

media.alt: The Usage panel with a short row per login in each pool, each with a ring, its name, how long it lasts and today's tokens. Clicking the Codex login opens its week chart and shuts it again, then a Claude login opens.

highlights.title: A patch asked about again says what changed
highlights.text: When a folder's patch needs trusting again, it says which files changed, in which commits, with the lines, so you can tell a dependency bump from something you didn't expect.

media.alt: A patch called stats marked "Changed since you trusted it" with a Trust button. It says package.json changed in commit 5c3fc77, Upgrade fluent-convex to 0.15, with the changed line from 0.13.0 to 0.15.0.

highlights.title: Every provider's models in a mixed pool
highlights.text: A pool with logins from several providers lists each one's models under its own heading in the model picker, so you can pick Gemini, Grok or Codex there too.

media.alt: The model picker on a Personal pool whose rail shows four logos. Gemini 3 Pro and Gemini 3 Flash are listed under their own heading, and picking Gemini 3 Pro puts it on the thread's chip.

highlights.title: A schedule's message is a card
highlights.text: A message from a schedule shows as a card with a clock, the schedule's name and when it runs, and its words as formatted text, code blocks included. On the iPhone too.

media.alt: A schedule's message as a card: a clock, "Merged PRs into the notes · Weekdays at 9:00", then its words with 0.4 notes in bold and a gh pr list command in a code block. The agent's reply follows.

added: Gemini on a Google plan, through Google's own Antigravity agent, with Gemini's logo in Usage, Settings and the model picker
A thread started on another of your machines sends its replies back to the thread that started it
changed: Autocorrect in the message box is off unless you turn it on in its right-click menu, as most of what you type to an agent is names and commands
The Updates panel says when its build is waiting behind other work, on which Mac and for how long
Permission cards from Gemini and other ACP agents are shorter for the common cases, and show everything for the rest
Starring, waking, marking read or bringing back a thread from search on the iPhone and Android shows at once
On the website, a message that fails to send keeps what you typed
fixed: A thread you'd just written to no longer sometimes archives itself when its turn ends
A link in a reply opens on the first click, even when the pointer slips a little as you press
GIFs play when the window isn't in front, and in the review gallery
Schedules keep the kind of login you picked in a mixed pool
The runner restarts itself cleanly after an unexpected error, and stops if it keeps failing
A setting an older CLI refuses no longer restarts the next thread's CLI
Phone notifications refused by the push relay are tried again
A second Hibernate tap on the iPhone before the row moves is ignored
